# Naviu combines AR directions with an AI guide for Japan


By OpenTools Team


Route overlays, camera questions and itinerary preferences perform different jobs.


##


Directions and questions


[TANGLE’s November 1 announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000004.000182356.html) describes Naviu for iOS and Android. A translucent AR route is overlaid on the streetscape; location‑based AI answers questions in a claimed 29 languages. Pointing the camera at temples, signs or shops provides another way to ask about the surroundings.


The route overlay addresses direction, while the guide interprets what a visitor encounters.


##


Preferences are planning inputs


[The company says itinerary generation considers dietary restrictions, interests, accessibility and available time](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000004.000182356.html) . An accessibility preference supplied to a planner is different from verification that a proposed path is accessible.


These are issuer‑described functions; we have not installed the app or tested its routes and translations.


Nakamise‑dori Street, Asakusa, April 2024; archive context, not Naviu use or an app‑verified route.
